title: Peppa Pig and the muddy puddles.
lines: Peppa is a happy pink piggy.
She lives in a little house on top of a hill, with her mummy, her daddy and her little brother George.
What he loves most is his toy dinosaur.
She hears a sound on the window.
Peppa and George look out of the window.
Not yet, darling, says Mummy Pig.
But they keep looking out of the window.
And then, at last, the rain stops.
The sun comes out from behind the clouds.
But put your boots on first.
Peppa puts on her red boots.
George puts on his blue boots.
And right at the bottom of the hill is the very biggest puddle.
Brown and smooth and very, very muddy.
She loves them more than anything in the whole world.
Peppa and George jump and jump.
Up and down, up and down.
They get completely brown with mud.
Their boots, their coats, even their snouts.
Then Peppa's friend Suzy Sheep comes by.
Suzy is wearing a white coat.
Do you want to jump too?
My mummy says I have to keep my coat clean.
Then you just have to put your boots on, she says.
Suzy runs home and comes back in her yellow raincoat and her green boots.
Then Danny Dog comes, and Rebecca Rabbit, and Pedro Pony.
They all jump in the big muddy puddle.
Then they hear a deep voice.
He is big and he wears glasses.
Do you want to jump too?
Daddy Pig looks at the muddy puddle.
I'm actually very good at jumping in muddy puddles.
The mud splashes all the way to the tree.
Mummy Pig comes to look too.
She shakes her head, but she's laughing.
Then Peppa and George go inside.
They take off their dirty clothes and have a bath.
The water turns brown, but the bubbles are white and soft.
George makes a beard out of bubbles.
That evening they lie in bed, tired.
Mummy, she says, can it rain again tomorrow?
Mummy laughs and gives her a little kiss on her snout.
